blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and September 2026, detached houses: listings fell from 63 in June to 50 in September (−20.6%), and it took 27.6% of the city’s 116 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings fell from 23 in June to 22 in September (−4.3%), and it took 28.6% of the city’s 35 sales over the period.

The monthly write-ups singled out Sunshine Hills Woods for detached houses in July (a sellers’ best bet); detached houses in September (a buyers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in August (a sellers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in June, July, September (a buyers’ best bet).

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Sunshine Hills Woods than in June?
faq.a: In Sunshine Hills Woods, listings of houses fell from 63 in June to 50 in September (−20.6%); condos and townhomes fell from 23 in June to 22 in September (−4.3%).

faq.q: How big is Sunshine Hills Woods compared with the rest of North Delta?
faq.a: In September 2026, Sunshine Hills Woods held 23.9% of the 209 houses listed in North Delta and 31.0% of the 71 condos and townhomes listed in North Delta.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Sunshine Hills Woods from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 32 houses and 10 condos and townhomes sold in Sunshine Hills Woods over those 4 months.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in Sunshine Hills Woods?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.
